content:
jun: Heads-up — onboarding sampleapp produced duplicate downstream calls when token rotated mid-stream and a 429 hit. We got two identical completions logged for the same user action.

tara: Ugh ok can you paste repro steps?

jun: Steps: start streaming completion with a long prompt, wait ~token expiry, server returns 429 on chunk N, client retries the whole request instead of resuming. Logs: `request_id=abc123 status=429 retry=1` then later `request_id=abc123 retry=2` but both produced side-effects.

alex: Are we attaching any idempotency header currently? I thought Go SDK attaches one for non-streaming only.

rohit: Correct — Rust and Python add an idempotency header for sync completion calls. Go omitted it for streaming due to the streaming API shape. Looks like a parity gap.

jun: Proposal: SDKs should send a stable idempotency token for the whole logical operation (even if streaming). Server can accept replays for a short grace window (eg 30s) and dedupe side-effects. Suggested header `x-rw-idempotency: <uuid>` and server-side check keyed by customer+model+idempotency.

tara: Agreed but we must be conservative: only automatically replay if the endpoint is marked idempotent (completion, embeddings). Do NOT enable replay for function-calls or webhooks by default.

alex: I'll open a small Go PR to add the header to the streaming client and make it opt-in behind `StreamReplay = true` config flag so we can roll it. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/pull/1234 (draft).

julie: Also add jittered backoff on the client when we hit 429 after token rotation — immediate full-retry makes the duplicate window worse. My suggestion: randomized base backoff between 200ms and 1200ms plus exponential cap.

ci-bot: build(go-sdk/pr-1234): passed unit tests, e2e replay-sim flaky on macos, rerunning.

rohit: We should add a sampleapp harness to intentionally cause token refresh mid-stream and assert the server dedupes. jun — can you add that?

jun: Yep, I'll add a simulate-refresh test in sampleapp and document recommended config. Snippet for docs:```http
POST /v1/completions
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <token>
         x-rw-idempotency: 3f2a9b8c-...
Body: { "model":"gpt-sorta", "prompt":"..." }
```

jun: Also plan: update SDK parity matrix + changelog entry. I will create DEVEX-789 and assign go-sdk & docs.

rohit: Filed DEVEX-789: "streaming idempotency parity + sampleapp harness" and assigned.

tara: When go PR is ready, let's coordinate with eng-runtime to make a short grace-window feature toggle on the server (default off). We need telemetry: `dedupe.count` and `dedupe.latency`.

julie: Quick ask — add a note in onboarding doc warning about non-idempotent function-calls and recommend idempotency keys at the app layer for those.

jun: Thanks team. I'll push sampleapp PR + docs draft today and link here. Will follow up in #eng-runtime for server toggle. :thumbsup:
